accounting: USDT-equivalent fee assumption; equal net BTC model quantity. This assumption is not account fee certification; the separate net-BTC-commission planner remains a diagnostic. Walk spot asks/perpetual bids at entry and spot bids/perpetual asks at valuation/exit. Observed book spread/depth plus separately assumed extra adverse drift/slippage are charged. Fees use each leg's quoted notional. Overhead accrues by actual elapsed seconds on total time after entry. No sum of independently funded scenarios, no annualized expected yield, no conversion into investor fiat profit.
causality: Append and fsync a decision before requesting entry/exit quotes. Capture actual receive times. An entry or exit outside its 60-minute window is never backdated. A crashed/failed entry or exit remains unknown; no restart at a favorable later quote. Daily failures and missing slots remain visible. Funding strictly after the whole entry hour and before the quote observation cutoff; keep signed payments, halve only positive receipts in stress. Capture only completed mark-price hours for margin evaluation.
data: Public Binance GET-only clock, exchangeInfo, depth, fundingRate and markPriceKlines. Persist raw successful and failed responses with URL, local request/receive times and SHA256. No authenticated data or order endpoint. Maximum 16 requests and 20 MB per invocation, no infinite retries. Both clock offsets <=5 seconds and request durations <=2 seconds. Paired book request-midpoint skew <=500 ms. Spot event freshness and actual simultaneous fills remain uncertified.
failure_policy: One durable attempt per daily UTC slot. Reject tampered freeze, malformed/duplicate data, clock reversals, incomplete journal and overlapping processes. Write status atomically. Pending entry and exit interruptions are terminal unknown observations. Distinguish completed, missed, failed, pending and no-position states. Return nonzero for new errors; do not discard raw data or repair ledger by deletion.
metrics: Modeled mark-to-liquidation profit for every cost case, funding/basis/cost decomposition, actual entry/quote times, known/missing daily slots, sampled drawdown, hourly margin coverage and breaches, final outcome only if observed. Calendar completion alone cannot certify profitability; one 84-day holding is not a statistically sufficient independent sample.
missing_and_margin: Funding must cover every complete 8-hour baseline bucket after the entry hour through the last due settlement bucket; additional valid events retained. Completed mark candles must be contiguous with valid OHLC. Missing funding/marks makes the affected valuation unknown; never fill with zero. Rebuilding published cashflow/mark data on a later day is allowed for diagnostics, without fabricating the missed contemporaneous quote. Hourly high collateral bound uses separate cash reserve, no spot collateral, 1% maintenance plus 0.5% close reserve, with an additional +30% mark jump. Exclude positive current-hour funding before testing the high. Incomplete entry/exit hours and actual liquidation rules remain uncertified; report coverage instead of labeling the account executable.
notification: The separate scheduling prompt should notify only on first entry, meaningful quality/status change, failure, margin breach, final outcome or required user information. Routine changing prices and unchanged status need no notification.
preservation: Separate research worktree and carry-forward-data directory; never change the existing v6 altcoin automation or ledger. No real capital, orders, paid services, authenticated accounts or other agents.
registration: Freeze specification and code before preflight and first decision. This is one new prospective operational observation, not a parameter search or a claim of independent authorship.
schedule_brasilia: Manual only, 21:15 Brasilia in each first UTC hour; no scheduler configured.
strategy: One BTCUSDT spot-long / equal-quantity USDT perpetual-short shadow holding. Open on the first scheduled entry observation; maintain fixed quantity until the scheduled final observation. No intermediate rebalancing, signal retuning, leverage borrowing or transfers from spot gains to futures. Initial account is 5000 USDT with target spot value at most 1250 USDT. Round down to the current common spot/futures lot step, validate current status, quantity and minimum-notional constraints.
